auth.description:
Your PandaDoc API key.

1. In PandaDoc, open **Settings > Integrations > API** (the Developer Dashboard).
2. Copy the **Sandbox** key for testing or the **Production** key for live documents.
3. Paste it here.

Sandbox keys are limited to 10 requests per minute and can only send documents to email addresses in your own domain.
description: Create, send and track documents, proposals and e-signatures.
triggers.documentCompleted.description: Triggers when a document is completed (all recipients have signed or approved).
triggers.documentCompleted.props.folder_: Only trigger for documents stored in these folders (leave empty for all).
triggers.documentCompleted.props.templat: Only trigger for documents created from these templates (leave empty for all).

triggers.documentStateChanged.props.filt: Only trigger when the document moves into one of these statuses (leave empty for all).

Filter by Update Type (no longer used)
